profile.headline: Web Developer @ Avorio Studios
profile.summary:
Hi, I’m Trisha! I’m a seasoned web developer with over 18 years of experience delivering cutting-edge digital solutions in fast-paced agency environments and as a freelancer. Known for creating pixel-perfect designs that seamlessly transform into functional, user-friendly websites, I bring a unique blend of creativity, technical expertise, and adaptability to every project.

I thrive on solving complex problems and staying ahead of industry trends, quickly mastering new technologies to deliver innovative results. My skill set spans all facets of web development, including designing and developing websites, ensuring ADA and HIPAA compliance, managing domains, setting up and troubleshooting email systems, branding, and implementing effective SEO strategies.

I am proficient in PHP, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, WordPress, Shopify, and Bootstrap. My primary focus has been on developing with WordPress and Shopify, but I also excel in creating custom-coded websites tailored to clients' unique needs.

My WordPress expertise includes designing and developing custom, fully responsive, and retina-ready themes enriched with advanced features like custom post types, plugin customizations, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF). Whether crafting elegant eCommerce platforms, integrating APIs, or building dynamic content solutions, I am committed to delivering exceptional results that drive success for clients across industries.

Let’s connect if you’re looking for a reliable and innovative web developer to bring your vision to life!

positions.title: Web Manager
positions.description:
Collaborate with project managers to identify and implement tailored products and solutions that meet client needs. Assist sales representatives by preparing detailed proposals and accurate quotes.

Actively participate in discovery calls with clients and project managers to gather requirements and define project scope.

Oversee the full lifecycle of web projects, ensuring they are completed on time and within budget. Provide strategic guidance on digital trends, recommending innovative solutions to improve client outcomes.

Mentor junior developers and guide them on best practices for web development. Coordinate with designers, copywriters, and developers to ensure cohesive project execution.

Design and develop 2-5 websites per month, spanning a range of complexity—from streamlined 5-page sites to comprehensive 100+ page platforms featuring custom functionality such as event calendars, eCommerce solutions, and API integrations.

Develop and refine workflows for website development, improving efficiency and scalability while ensuring compliance with industry standards and best practices, including ADA accessibility.

positions.description:
Serve as a mentor to junior developers, UX/UI designers, providing design and development feedback on a daily basis.
Serve as a resource for web strategists, working with them to discover products and solutions to best fit the clients needs.
Serve as a resource for project managers and junior developers to troubleshoot technical concerns as they arose.
Daily scheduling management - ensuring each developer and designer had a reasonable workload and juggling timelines outlined in scope of work.
Participating in discovery calls with project managers and clients to gather information about the project.
Developed between 2 and 5 websites monthly, ranging from simple 5 page websites to 100+ page websites with custom functionality (Event Calendars, eCommerce, API integrations, etc.).
Launch between 20-30 websites monthly, including setting up redirects, updating DNS records, installing SSL certificates, setup of Google Analytics, Tag Manager and Search Console.
